records.jp: いた！　みんな、こっちだ！
records.en_original: There you are! Guys, over here!
records.en: There you are! Guys, over here!

records.jp: 久野さん！<CR>いったい、何があったんですか！？
records.en_original: Kirara! What happened?!
records.en: Kirara! What happened?!

records.jp: わからない。異灰に襲われそうにはなったけど、<CR>わたしが守ったのに……
records.en_original: I don't know. She was almost attacked by a Testa, but I protected her...
records.en: I don't know. She was almost attacked by a Testa, but I protected her...

records.jp: ちょっと待って！<CR>これって……
records.en_original: Wait a minute! This is...
records.en: Wait a minute! This is...

records.jp: 間違いない、詩帆の時と一緒。<CR>きららの中にクイーンがいる！
records.en_original: No mistake, it's just like with Shiho. A Queen is inside Kirara!
records.en: No mistake, it's just like with Shiho. A Queen is inside Kirara!

records.jp: く、クイーン！？<CR>うそ、どうして！
records.en_original: A Queen?! No way, why?!
records.en: A Queen?! No way, why?!

records.jp: そんな……今まで、すごい張り切ってたのに……
records.en_original: No way...she was so fired up until now.
records.en: No way...she was so fired up until now.

records.jp: リーダー？<CR>もしかして、何か心当たりあるの？
records.en_original: Leader? Do you have any idea what's going on?
records.en: Leader? Do you have any idea what's going on?

records.jp: 「実は、きららは脱隊を申し出ていた」
records.en_original: Actually, Kirara asked to leave the group.
records.en: Actually, Kirara asked to leave the group.

records.jp: だ、脱隊って……そんなの聞いてないんだけど！？
records.en_original: Leave the group?! I never heard anything about that!
records.en: Leave the group?! I never heard anything about that!

records.jp: まさか、きららがそんなことを……
records.en_original: I can't believe Kirara would do something like that...
records.en: I can't believe Kirara would do something like that...

records.jp: 原因はやっぱり、劣等感、でしょうか……
records.en_original: Was the reason an inferiority complex?
records.en: Was the reason an inferiority complex?

records.jp: 思いつく原因はそれくらいよね。<CR>で、そこをクイーンに付け込まれた……ってことかな
records.en_original: That's the only cause I can think of. And that's what the Queen took advantage of...right?
records.en: That's the only cause I can think of. And that's what the Queen took advantage of...right?

records.jp: ……わたしのせいだ
records.en_original: It's all my fault...
records.en: It's all my fault...

records.jp: 樹里のことばっか考えないようにって<CR>前向こうって思って
records.en_original: I've been trying not to think about Juri, and trying to keep facing forward...
records.en: I've been trying not to think about Juri, and trying to keep facing forward...

records.jp: ……周りのこと全然見えてなくて、<CR>わたし、自分のことばっかり……
records.en_original: I wasn't paying enough attention to anything around me. I was just focused on myself...
records.en: I wasn't paying enough attention to anything around me. I was just focused on myself...

records.jp: どうにかしてきららを助けないと……
records.en_original: I have to find a way to save Kirara.
records.en: I have to find a way to save Kirara.

records.jp: リーダー、お願い。<CR>わたしを、きららの中に連れてって！
records.en_original: Leader, please. Take me inside Kirara!
records.en: Leader, please. Take me inside Kirara!

records.jp: 「けして安全ではない。それでも構わないか？」
records.en_original: It's by no means safe. Are you still willing to go?
records.en: It's by no means safe. Are you still willing to go?

records.jp: ……うん、構わない。<CR>きららを助けるためなんだから
records.en_original: Definitely. Because I have to save Kirara.
records.en: Definitely. Because I have to save Kirara.

records.jp: ならば、その間は私たちで二人を守ろう。<CR>異灰には指一本触れさせない
records.en_original: Then let's protect the two of them until it's over. We won't let the Testa lay a finger on them.
records.en: Then let's protect the two of them until it's over. We won't let the Testa lay a finger on them.

records.jp: だね。よーし、がんばっちゃうぞー！
records.en_original: Yeah! All right, I'm gonna give it my all!
records.en: Yeah! All right, I'm gonna give it my all!

records.jp: リーダーさん、安住さん。<CR>久野さんのこと、お願いします
records.en_original: Leader, Nanaka. Please, take care of Kirara.
records.en: Leader, Nanaka. Please, take care of Kirara.

records.jp: うん……そっちも気を付けて。<CR>リーダー、お願い
records.en_original: Yeah... You be careful too. Leader, I'm counting on you.
records.en: Yeah... You be careful too. Leader, I'm counting on you.

records.jp: きらら！
records.en_original: Kirara!
records.en: Kirara!

records.jp: あのね、わたし……きららに謝りに来た！
records.en_original: Hey, Kirara... I came here to apologize!
records.en: Hey, Kirara... I came here to apologize!

records.jp: わたし、自分のことで手いっぱいで、<CR>全然きららのこと見てあげられなかった
records.en_original: I was so wrapped up in my own problems, I couldn't see what you were going through at all.
records.en: I was so wrapped up in my own problems, I couldn't see what you were going through at all.

records.jp: それに怖かったの。<CR>もうこれ以上、大切な人が傷つくのが
records.en_original: And I was scared. I couldn't bear the thought of losing someone important to me again.
records.en: And I was scared. I couldn't bear the thought of losing someone important to me again.

records.jp: わたしがいっぱい頑張れば、<CR>その分だけ守れると思ってた
records.en_original: I thought the more I tried my best, the more I could protect everyone.
records.en: I thought the more I tried my best, the more I could protect everyone.

records.jp: そのせいで、きららを悩ませてたって気づかなかった。<CR>本当にごめん……
records.en_original: I didn't realize I was making things harder for you, Kirara. I'm really sorry.
records.en: I didn't realize I was making things harder for you, Kirara. I'm really sorry.

records.jp: でも、きららが役に立たないなんて思ったことは<CR>一度もない！
records.en_original: But I've never—not even once—thought that you were useless!
records.en: But I've never—not even once—thought that you were useless!

records.jp: だから、一緒に戻ろう。<CR>クイーンなんか、追い出してさ
records.en_original: So let's go back together. And kick that Queen out!
records.en: So let's go back together. And kick that Queen out!

records.jp: 嫌だ
records.en_original: No.
records.en: No.

records.jp: なんで？<CR>……わたしのこと、嫌いになっちゃった？
records.en_original: Why? ...Do you hate me now?
records.en: Why? ...Do you hate me now?

records.jp: なーなのことは好き。<CR>……好きだった
records.en_original: I like you, Nana. ...I used to like you.
records.en: I like you, Nana. ...I used to like you.

records.jp: 過去に囚われてて、でもどうすることもできなくて、<CR>立ち止まって、苦しんで、後ろを向いて
records.en_original: Trapped in the past, unable to do anything, stuck, suffering, and always looking back.
records.en: Trapped in the past, unable to do anything, stuck, suffering, and always looking back.

records.jp: なーなときららは同じなんだって。<CR>そう思ったから好きだった
records.en_original: I liked you because I thought you and I were the same.
records.en: I liked you because I thought you and I were the same.

records.jp: でも、今のなーなは違う。強い意志があって、実力も<CR>あって、前に進もうとしてる。きららを置いて
records.en_original: But you're different now, Nana. You have a strong will, strength, and you're moving on. Leaving me behind.
records.en: But you're different now, Nana. You have a strong will, strength, and you're moving on. Leaving me behind.

records.jp: だから、今のなーなは……嫌い
records.en_original: That's why...I don't like you the way you are now.
records.en: That's why...I don't like you the way you are now.

records.jp: なーな、きららを置いてかないで
records.en_original: Don't leave me behind, Nana.
records.en: Don't leave me behind, Nana.

records.jp: なっ！？
records.en_original: What?!
records.en: What?!

records.jp: すぅ……はぁ……
records.en_original: *Deep breath*
records.en: *Deep breath*

records.jp: ……大丈夫。<CR>今のきららが正常じゃないことくらい、わかってるし
records.en_original: ...It's okay. I know she's not really herself right now.
records.en: ...It's okay. I know she's not really herself right now.

records.jp: きららの気持ち……よくわかった。<CR>嫌われても、仕方ないと思う
records.en_original: I understand how you feel, Kirara. I guess I can't blame you for hating me.
records.en: I understand how you feel, Kirara. I guess I can't blame you for hating me.

records.jp: けど、きららは自分のこと、ちゃんとわかってない。<CR>戦闘にばかり目を向けすぎてる
records.en_original: But Kirara, you don't really understand yourself right now. You're too focused on just fighting.
records.en: But Kirara, you don't really understand yourself right now. You're too focused on just fighting.

records.jp: なんだと？
records.en_original: What did you say?
records.en: What did you say?

records.jp: 確かにわたしは戦闘が得意だけど、<CR>たまたまきららはそうじゃなかっただけの話でしょ？
records.en_original: Sure, I'm good at fighting, but that's just how it turned out for me. It just happens that you're not, that's all.
records.en: Sure, I'm good at fighting, but that's just how it turned out for me. It just happens that you're not, that's all.

records.jp: たとえば高岡みたいに、自分の目を使って<CR>チームに貢献することだってできる
records.en_original: For example, you could use your eyes to contribute to the team, like Yukiko.
records.en: For example, you could use your eyes to contribute to the team, like Yukiko.

records.jp: 今日だって、それ以外の時も、きららの<CR>予知能力があるから、わたしは動けた
records.en_original: It's always because of your foresight that I can do what I do, Kirara. Even today.
records.en: It's always because of your foresight that I can do what I do, Kirara. Even today.

records.jp: 今のきららは、子どもが拗ねてるのと一緒。<CR>諦めて後ろを向いたまま、前を向く勇気が持てないだけ
records.en_original: Right now, you're just sulking like a little kid—giving up, looking away, and not having the courage to face forward.
records.en: Right now, you're just sulking like a little kid—giving up, looking away, and not having the courage to face forward.

records.jp: ふざけるな！<CR>きららのことなんて何も知らないくせに！
records.en_original: Don't act like you know me! You don't know anything about me!
records.en: Don't act like you know me! You don't know anything about me!

records.jp: そう……わたし、きららのこと全然理解してない。<CR>そして、きららもきっと、わたしのことを――
records.en_original: That's true... I don't really understand you at all, Kirara. And I'm sure you don't really understand me, either.
records.en: That's true... I don't really understand you at all, Kirara. And I'm sure you don't really understand me, either.

records.jp: だから、これからわかっていきたい。<CR>一緒に生きて。一緒に戦って
records.en_original: So I want us to understand each other from now on. Live together. Fight together.
records.en: So I want us to understand each other from now on. Live together. Fight together.

records.jp: きらら。悪いけど、わたしはもう振り向かない。<CR>前に進むって決めたから
records.en_original: Sorry, Kirara, but I won't look back anymore. I've decided to move forward.
records.en: Sorry, Kirara, but I won't look back anymore. I've decided to move forward.

records.jp: なーな……
records.en_original: Nana...
records.en: Nana...

records.jp: でも、きららを置いてったりしない
records.en_original: But I won't leave you behind, Kirara.
records.en: But I won't leave you behind, Kirara.

records.jp: きららが前を向けないなら<CR>――わたしが引っ張っていくから
records.en_original: If you can't face forward, then I'll pull you along.
records.en: If you can't face forward, then I'll pull you along.

records.jp: この手があれば、いつだってきららのことを<CR>感じられる
records.en_original: As long as I have this hand, I can always feel you're here, Kirara.
records.en: As long as I have this hand, I can always feel you're here, Kirara.

records.jp: きららはきららのやり方でついてきてよ。<CR>行く手が塞がってたら、わたしが切り開く
records.en_original: Kirara, just come with me in your own way. If something's in our way, I'll clear the path.
records.en: Kirara, just come with me in your own way. If something's in our way, I'll clear the path.

records.jp: だから、わたしが進むべき道を教えて。<CR>……きららなら、できるでしょ？
records.en_original: So show me which way I should go. Only you can do that, right, Kirara?
records.en: So show me which way I should go. Only you can do that, right, Kirara?

records.jp: どうして……
records.en_original: Why are you...?
records.en: Why are you...?

records.jp: わたしたち、友達じゃん
records.en_original: Because we're friends.
records.en: Because we're friends.

records.jp: なーな、ごめん……ごめんなさい。<CR>きらら、酷いことをたくさん……
records.en_original: Nana, I'm so sorry... I said so many awful things...
records.en: Nana, I'm so sorry... I said so many awful things...

records.jp: いいよ。謝らなくて
records.en_original: It's okay. No need to apologize.
records.en: It's okay. No need to apologize.

records.jp: 戻ろう、みんなのところへ
records.en_original: Let's go back to where everyone else is.
records.en: Let's go back to where everyone else is.

records.jp: リーダー！<CR>きっと今ならクイーンを追い出せる！
records.en_original: Leader! I know we can kick the Queen out now!
records.en: Leader! I know we can kick the Queen out now!

records.jp: お願い、力を貸して！
records.en_original: Please, lend me your strength!
records.en: Please, lend me your strength!
